sources.snippet: Kriti AI is an AI-powered voice assistant system designed for the hospitality industry, enabling automated hotel and restaurant reservations through natural conversations. It combines speech recognition, NLP, and machine learning to provide 24/7 booking services, personalized guest experiences, and intelligent management features.

sources.title: Transcribe phone audio with enhanced models - Google Cloud
sources.snippet: Send a request To best transcribe audio captured on a phone, like a phone call or voicemail, you can set the model field in your RecognitionConfig payload to phone_call. The model field tells Cloud Speech-to-Text API which speech recognition model to use for the transcription request.
